Please read the following multiple-choice questions and provide the most likely correct answer based on the options given.

Context: None

Question: A frequency-modulated signal with a carrier frequency of 100MHz, is fluctuating at a rate of 100 times per second between the frequencies 100.001 MHz and 99.999MHz. (a) Find f_m, the modulating frequency and calculate\Deltaf, frequency deviation. (b) If the frequency swing is now between the frequencies 100.002 MHz and 99.998 MHz, state if there is any effect. (c) Determine the modulation index \beta in each case.

Options: 
A. f_m = 100Hz, \Deltaf_1 = 2kHz, \Deltaf_2 = 4kHz,  eta_1 = 20,  eta_2 = 40
B. f_m = 50Hz, \Deltaf_1 = 1kHz, \Deltaf_2 = 2kHz, \beta_1 = 20, \beta_2 = 40
C. f_m = 100Hz, \Deltaf_1 = 1kHz, \Deltaf_2 = 3kHz, \beta_1 = 10, \beta_2 = 30
D. f_m = 150Hz, \Deltaf_1 = 1.5kHz, \Deltaf_2 = 3kHz, \beta_1 = 15, \beta_2 = 30
E. f_m = 200Hz, \Deltaf_1 = 1kHz, \Deltaf_2 = 2kHz,  eta_1 = 10,  eta_2 = 20
F. f_m = 125Hz, \Deltaf_1 = 2.5kHz, \Deltaf_2 = 5kHz, \beta_1 = 25, \beta_2 = 50
G. f_m = 100Hz, \Deltaf_1 = 3kHz, \Deltaf_2 = 6kHz,  eta_1 = 30,  eta_2 = 60
H. f_m = 50Hz, \Deltaf_1 = 4kHz, \Deltaf_2 = 8kHz,  eta_1 = 80,  eta_2 = 160
I. f_m = 75Hz, \Deltaf_1 = 1.5kHz, \Deltaf_2 = 2kHz, \beta_1 = 30, \beta_2 = 40
J. f_m = 200Hz, \Deltaf_1 = 0.5kHz, \Deltaf_2 = 1kHz, \beta_1 = 5, \beta_2 = 10

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
